title: Emergency Call-Out Pricing and Weekend Session Minimum on TimeBank Remote Support
content:
Remote call-out schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours. The class, priority at resolution and channel are read from the session's ticket in the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history; a weekday is Monday to Friday and a Saturday or Sunday is read from the resolution's date.

- **Emergency call-out.** A weekday remote session resolved in the after-hours class on a ticket standing at P1 when resolved and reported by phone is an emergency call-out, and its first 60 minutes are priced at the block's emergency multiplier instead of the after-hours multiplier, the remaining minutes keeping the after-hours multiplier. In figures: the first 60 of the minutes drawn (all of them when fewer than 60 are drawn) are weighted by the emergency multiplier divided by the after-hours multiplier of the block's size, and the remaining minutes are weighted by 1. An emergency call-out is recorded in the emergency band.
- **Weekend session.** A remote session resolved on a Saturday or Sunday has its minutes raised to at least 120.
- **Any other session** keeps its minutes as the floors on its rounded minutes leave them.

| Session | Effect on hypothetical 45 minutes drawn |
|---|---|
| weekday, after-hours class, P1 at resolution, reported by phone | all 45 minutes at the emergency weighting |
| Saturday or Sunday | raised to 120 minutes |
| weekday, after-hours class, P2 at resolution | 45 minutes, unweighted |

Hypothetical figures for a weekday emergency call-out of 90 minutes drawn on a size with after-hours multiplier 1.25 and emergency multiplier 1.75: 60 minutes at 1.75 and 30 minutes at 1.25 give 105 plus 37.5, that is 142.5 weighted minutes, or 2.375 hours, 2.38 after rounding, at the technician ratio.
